title: Nominate-then-Adjudicate: LLM-Assisted One-Pass and Per-Instance MIP Solver Tuning
abstract: arXiv:2610.29391v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Mixed-integer programming solvers expose hundreds or even thousands of parameters whose best setting varies per instance, yet per-instance search is prohibitively expensive. We frame this as configuration for heterogeneous Big Data optimization workloads and propose a nominate-then-adjudicate pipeline built around two design choices. First, a fixed portfolio is sampled once and reused across instances, removing per-instance configuration search at inference; on the evaluated families, the resulting shortlist retains substantial oracle headroom, making selection within it the empirical focus. Second, the fixed 20-feature representation can map structurally different instances to the same vector, preventing a feature-only selector from distinguishing them even when they prefer different configurations. The foundation model receives no task-specific weight updates, and selection is one-pass: one model call and no solver calls at inference.

translated_title: 先提名后裁决：基于大语言模型辅助的单次遍历逐实例MIP求解器调优
translated_abstract: 混合整数规划（MIP）求解器暴露出数百甚至数千个参数，其最佳设置因实例而异，但逐实例的参数搜索代价过高。我们将此问题框架化为面向异构大数据优化工作负载的配置问题，并提出一个“先提名后裁决”流水线，该流水线围绕两个设计选择构建。首先，对固定组合进行一次采样并在多个实例间复用，从而在推理阶段免除了逐实例的配置搜索；在所评估的实例族上，所得的候选名单保留了可观的神谕性能空间，使得在该名单内进行选择成为实证研究的重点。其次，固定的20维特征表示可能将结构上不同的实例映射到同一向量，导致仅基于特征的选择器即使在这些实例偏好不同配置时也无法区分它们。基础模型不接收任何任务特定的权重更新，且选择过程为单次遍历：推理时仅需一次模型调用、无需任何求解器调用。
tldr: 该论文提出“先提名后裁决”流水线：先一次性采样并复用固定配置组合作为候选名单，再由无任务微调的大语言模型在推理时以一次模型调用、零求解器调用完成逐实例选择，从而无需昂贵的逐实例配置搜索即可实现MIP求解器的逐实例调优。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a nominate-then-adjudicate pipeline that samples a fixed portfolio once as a shortlist and uses a task-untuned LLM to perform one-pass per-instance selection (one model call, zero solver calls) at inference, enabling per-instance MIP solver tuning without costly per-instance configuration search.
